purpose: Show how provider-specific tracker operations satisfy the provider-neutral tracker.* capability contract without copying planning logic.
canonical_truth_rule: Exactly one project-selected work-tracker or local artifact family owns task status. Provider mappings may change storage and operation shape, never ownership semantics.

providers.discovery: live connector or CLI action discovery

capabilities.tracker.read: issues, pull requests when explicitly configured as a request surface, comments, labels, relationships
capabilities.tracker.query: search issues with bounded repository and semantic markers
capabilities.tracker.update: edit issue, comment, label, assign, close
capabilities.tracker.change_state: open, reopen, close, or mark duplicate through mapped issue state and reason
capabilities.tracker.link_dependencies: native sub-issue or dependency action when live provider exposes it; otherwise bounded body links

limitations: A git remote does not prove tracker access or authorization.

providers.discovery: live connector or MCP action discovery

capabilities.tracker.query: bounded issue search using project-approved fields and planning markers
capabilities.tracker.create: create issue in an authorized project
capabilities.tracker.change_state: authorized workflow transition using the project state mapping

limitations: Status and field names require project mapping; never infer them from generic Jira vocabulary.

providers.discovery: live connector or MCP action discovery

capabilities.tracker.read: issues, projects, comments, states, and relationships
capabilities.tracker.query: bounded issue/project search using team-approved planning markers
capabilities.tracker.create: create issue in an authorized team
capabilities.tracker.update: patch state, assignee, labels, or comments
capabilities.tracker.change_state: authorized state transition using the selected team workflow mapping
capabilities.tracker.link_dependencies: blocking or related issue relationship when exposed

limitations: Team and workflow-state mappings belong to the target project profile.

capabilities.tracker.read: read the canonical index and work-item files
capabilities.tracker.query: read the canonical index and match stable planning identities and revisions
capabilities.tracker.create: create one work-item file or append to the canonical project-declared ledger
capabilities.tracker.update: bounded update to the canonical local artifact
capabilities.tracker.change_state: bounded state update in the canonical local artifact with expected-current-state check
capabilities.tracker.link_dependencies: stable artifact identifiers or links recorded in the canonical local artifact

limitations: No automatic fallback location exists; the Project Capability Profile or project convention must name it.
Concurrency and atomic claims may be unavailable.

forbidden_behaviors: Defaulting to a provider because a remote, CLI, connector, or remembered tool name exists.
Creating a second local ledger when the project already has a canonical tracker.
Copying Product, BA, planning, triage, or Wayfinder decision logic into a provider adapter.
Treating configured labels, states, fields, child links, assignments, or dependency links as universally available.
